title: A typed event emitter
hints: `Events[K]` is the payload type for event `K`, so the listener parameter is `(payload: Events[K]) => void`. Inside the class, one `Map` from event name to an array of listeners does the storing.

Store listeners with a looser type (`(payload: never) => void`) and cast when you add and call them: TypeScript cannot see that each name always goes with its own payload type, but your public signatures guarantee it.
rules: Make the class generic: class Emitter<Events>.
Constrain the event name with K extends keyof Events.
